name: Alpha Partner USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Alpha Partners' BSC-only dollar token whose backing is described only as protocol-managed collateral and liquidity reserves; mechanism opaque.
collateral: Undisclosed and unverified. AP Web3 / Alpha Partners markets USDA as 1:1 USD-backed by reserves with 'FDIC protection', but publishes no reserve composition, proof of reserves, or attestation; the FDIC claim is unsubstantiated (FDIC does not insure stablecoins). Backing is opaque.
pegMechanism: Undocumented. The issuer publishes no mint/redeem or peg-maintenance mechanism. On-chain USDA is a BSC ERC-20 with a role-gated mint, an address blacklist, and modifiable transfer tax/fees; no peg-stabilization process is described.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: Alpha Partners' USDA is a BSC ERC-20 whose verified contract exposes a role-gated mint() callable only by holders of a MINT role, with role-based admin controls for minting, blacklisting and tax parameters and no on-chain supply cap; the backing mechanism is otherwise undocumented.

controls.label: USDA MINT role-gated token contract
controls.capDescription: Contract has no maximum supply cap; addresses granted the MINT role can issue USDA without an on-chain limit.
controls.evidence: The verified USDA token contract on BscScan exposes a mint() function restricted to a MINT role and role-based admin controls (mint, blacklist, tax ratios) with no supply cap. Actual MINT role holder addresses remain unresolved.

review.evidence: USDA contract exists on BSC (17,339-byte bytecode confirmed at block 103633267; ~87M tokens minted per storage slot 0x2). BscScan-verified contract source shows a role-gated mint() restricted to the MINT role (keccak256('MINT') = 0xfdf81848…). Contract is NOT verified on Sourcify. No RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events found via eth_getLogs (non-enumerable AccessControl). getRoleMemberCount reverts (non-enumerable). Cannot determine which address(es) hold the MINT role or ADMIN_ROLE without knowing candidate addresses.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve which address(es) hold the MINT role (keccak256('MINT') = 0xfdf81848136595c31bb5f76217767372bc4bf906663038eb38381131ea27ecba) and the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Non-enumerable AccessControl; no RoleGranted events emitted; requires knowing candidate addresses to call hasRole().

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDA presents an issuer-controlled one-dollar reserve claim; weak disclosures affect evidence quality but not the mechanism family.
